assumptions.note: e = share of warned breaks an operator prevents; not measurable from this data

models.hawkes: self-exciting hazard, 3 parameters, break history only
models.sensor_gbm: LightGBM on 531 sensor features + grade, no history
models.hybrid_gbm: LightGBM boosted from the Hawkes log-odds (init_score): learns sensor corrections to the hazard
models.hybrid_superpose: Hawkes excitation (mu = 0) superposed with a sensor-learned background intensity: LightGBM trained on quiet rows (>= 2 h since the last break); P = 1 - (1 - P_exc)(1 - P_bg)
models.hybrid_logistic: L2 logistic regression on sensor features + Hawkes log-odds

chance.method: per-block circular shift of each score; random_iid = uniform row scores

ap_chance.method: per-block circular shift of each score; AP on first-break rows / quiet rows

lead_check.method: first-break PR-AUC with positives restricted to rows >= k rows before the break (negatives = all label-0 test rows); per-block rotation null as in ap_chance
